subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: Most users skip this feature, but it's the best part. See what you missed.
body_paragraphs: I was up at 2AM last Tuesday, staring at a blank screen. I'd just spent an hour scrolling through date ideas, and nothing felt right. Then I remembered something I'd built months ago and almost forgot—a feature so simple, I almost buried it.

Turns out, most users skip it. They think it's too basic, or they just don't notice it. But the ones who try it? They plan 4x more dates in their first month. It's not about the spark; it's about the moment you stop thinking and just act.

That feature is Tonight's Date. One tap on a mood—cozy, adventurous, playful, healing—and in 30 seconds, your next date is planned. No scrolling, no debating, no planning fatigue. Just you and your partner, ready for tonight.

Open the app now. Look at the home screen. Tap the card that says 'Tonight's Date.' Pick a mood. That's it. P.S. Your partner will get a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment—not a boring notification. Try it before you forget.
